breaking_changes.BC_description: SVGO v4 requires Node.js >=16.0.0, dropping support for earlier versions. Projects running on Node.js versions below 16 will no longer be able to use SVGO v4.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Upgrade the Node.js runtime to version 16 or higher to use SVGO v4.

breaking_changes.BC_description: The plugin 'removeViewBox' is no longer included in the default 'preset-default' plugin set. This change preserves SVG scalability by default.
The plugin 'removeTitle' is no longer included in the default 'preset-default' plugin set. This change preserves accessibility by default.
The plugin 'removeScriptElement' has been renamed to 'removeScripts' because it removes not only `<script>` elements but also event handlers and script URIs.

Direct imports from internal SVGO modules (e.g., 'svgo/lib/xast.js', 'svgo/lib/builtin', 'svgo/plugins/preset-default') are no longer supported. Only the public API via top-level 'svgo' or 'svgo/browser' is allowed.
The browser bundle must now be imported from 'svgo/browser' instead of 'svgo/dist/svgo.browser.js'.

The `querySelector`, `querySelectorAll`, and `matches` functions now require a third argument — a map of nodes to their parents — when the CSS selector traverses parent or sibling relationships (e.g., 'div > span'). This affects custom plugins using such selectors.
SVGO no longer provides default exports. All public API exports are now named exports only.
